description: Work out customer lifetime value (gross profit over the average lifetime), its ratio to the cost of winning a customer and the months to win that cost back, from revenue per customer, gross margin, monthly churn and acquisition cost. Send numbers only (percentages as 5 for 5%). Answers a headline, the figures behind it and notes. Arithmetic on your own numbers, not financial advice. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

arpa.description: Average revenue per customer, per month

cac.description: Cost to win one customer. A month's sales and marketing spend, divided by the customers it won.

currency.description: The sign money is written with; "none" for bare numbers. Default "$".

margin.description: Gross margin (%). What's left of revenue after hosting, payment fees and support.

name: calculate_ltv_cac
title: Calculate LTV : CAC
